system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

Implanted computer chips and memory connected to your brain essentially give you greater processing capacity. This makes you twice as efficient (a x2 force multiplier) when making Intelligence (Computers) tests. You gain a +2 bonus on tests, particularly Intelligence tests, where these abilities would be of some benefit. If you also have a commlink, you can connect to local data and cellular networks to transmit and receive data.
